initial_query: Find an existing school building to create a spring section (sezione primavera) for 14 children, integrated into an existing kindergarten in Turin with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.
submitted_query: Find an existing school building to create a spring section (sezione primavera) for 14 children, integrated into an existing kindergarten in Turin with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.
final_sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE surface_area >= 180 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

I prefer properties near public transport.

requirements.description: User asks for a building near public transport. Threshold set at the 75th percentile of mobility (70.93), rounded to 71.

Energy class C or better (A1 through C). The request asks for a building in energy class C or better. The 180 sqm gross floor area, 14-child capacity, Turin location and public transport proximity are not energy-related columns and are not filtered here.

The user explicitly requires at least 180 sqm of gross floor area. The capacity of 14 children is not converted into an area filter. Energy class and proximity to public transport are not reference columns and were ignored. Turin is a geographic reference handled by the Location Agent, so comune_code was not set.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE surface_area >= 180 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on surface_area >= 180, energy_class in A1-A4/B/C, mobility >= 71, and a 3.0 km haversine radius around (45.0677551, 7.6824892). The tipologia_bene_immobile requirement was omitted because that column is not in filterable_columns. Results are ordered by distance from the coordinates, nearest first.
